metric: parameters, FLOPs per query, peak memory, latency
flops_convention: FLOPs = 2 x multiply-accumulate, forward pass, batch 1; estimates use the stated token counts / resolutions and exclude data movement

components.name: selector (logistic pair gate + hand pool rule + 6 scalars)

params.detail: 17-dim base gate + 10-dim pair gate coefficients + alpha/beta/margin/cap/k/p_sel

flops_per_query.detail: SigLIP vision tower (729 tokens, d=1152, 27 layers) + 2*params*(prompt+generated) LLM term

latency.detail: cold-image first query 49.88s, second cold image 0.69s (device briefly uncontended), warm same-image queries [48.32, 49.49, 37.71]s; the 0.69s cold pass shows the hardware can serve a query in well under a second - the spread is concurrent load from other jobs on the shared RTX 4090. The run's historical extraction measured 0.6-1.8 s/expression.

flops_per_query.detail: DETR-style encoder/decoder, 900 queries, d=256, 6 layers, ~10k tokens + ResNet-50 backbone ~4 GFLOPs

latency.detail: min of 3 genuinely-uncached detects [0.311, 0.162, 0.15]s (shared GPU under concurrent load); the bulk extraction of this run averaged 0.21 s/detect (8945 detections in 1871 s, exp109a log)

components.name: SAM ViT-H proposals + CLIP ViT-B/16 region scoring (released scorer)

flops_per_query.detail: SAM encoder 1024^2 (4096 tokens, d=1280, 32 layers) + prompt decoder ~0.12 TFLOPs + 63 CLIP crops at 224^2

latency.detail: 63 proposals, points-per-side 8, genuine cache miss (unique key), internal extract() time; wall clock 4.402s; bulk box-prompted SAM averaged 0.10 s/mask (8862 in 906 s, exp109a log)

totals.note: no component receives gradient updates; the only fitted quantities are the selector's 33 coefficients/scalars
totals.end_to_end_latency_breakdown: min warm box query (measured now, shared GPU under load) + 0.21 s/term detector (bulk-run rate) + released scoring amortised per image; the run's historical box-query figure is 0.6-1.8 s/expression on a quiet machine
totals.latency_conditions: all wall-clock numbers were measured on the shared RTX 4090 while other jobs held the device busy; bulk-run rates from this run's logs (exp109a) and the paper's historical 0.6-1.8 s/expression figure are quoted for the uncontended regime

training_time: Frozen components: every base component (SAM ViT-H, CLIP ViT-B/16, LLaVA-OneVision-7B, GroundingDINO-base) is frozen off the shelf; no gradient step is taken to fit any of them. Trained components (declared, both tiny): (i) the RefCOCO-family learned selector head (component-provenance promotion, 2026-10-15; component_provenance.json) -- a HistGradientBoostingClassifier, 250 depth-3 boosting iterations over 8 features, fitted once on the RefCOCO-family train-carved held-out tune refs (on the order of a few thousand fitted split/leaf values, seconds of CPU per dataset); and (ii) the gRefCOCO part-acceptance prior (HistGradientBoostingRegressor, 250 depth-3 iterations over 12 features; transfer_wall.json). The training-free realization trains nothing; its only fitting is the selector's configuration and coefficients, fitted by six 300-trial Optuna studies on held-out train-derived rows (four gRefCOCO studies: exp87/exp108/exp110/exp117; two RefCOCO-family studies). Total fitting cost is wall-clock CPU/GPU time of those studies, on the order of 10 GPU-hours; the released-pipeline precompute (SAM proposals + CLIP features + VLM/detector caches) dominates the run's total compute.
